summary.text: Susan Ruiz is a Democratic state representative who has represented District 23 since 2019 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A social worker, she is the ranking minority member of the Health and Human Services Committee.

paragraphs.text: Susan Ruiz was born in Houston, Texas, and graduated from Jefferson Davis High School.
She earned bachelor's and master's degrees in social work from Our Lady of the Lake University in San Antonio, Texas.
Her professional experience includes serving as an emergency services manager, a service coordinator at the Wyandot Center, and an intensive community services team leader at Truman Medical Center.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she is a first-generation college graduate, moved to Kansas in 1993, and has lived in Shawnee for 28 years.
Ruiz assumed office in the Kansas House in 2019.

For 2025 and 2026 she is assigned to the Social Services Budget, Veterans and Military, and Health and Human Services committees, serving as ranking minority member on Health and Human Services, along with two oversight committees.

In the survey, she listed her priorities as fully funding public schools and special education, making it easier to vote, and protecting access to healthcare, including mental and reproductive health.
